author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the Artemis 2 mission. The first time in decades we're heading back to the moon and for the next 10 days hoping nothing goes wrong, the next step will be finally landing again. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: We're Going Back To The Moon...
